item.title: Imouto (Ane) wa Ani (Otouto) no Seiheki o Yugamasetai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shirokuma Dango
  • 発売日: 2025-03-28
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (35 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹(姉)は兄(弟)の性癖を歪ませたい！
  • 英語名: Imouto (Ane) wa Ani (Otouto) no Seiheki o Yugamasetai!

あらすじ

My older sister, Satsuki, is kind, caring, and soothing, and is the embodiment of the ideal older sister. My cute younger sister, Kae, is energetic and tomboyish, and she is attached to me, following me everywhere. I spent happy days surrounded by the two of them and our parents.

item.title: Iyashi no Megami no Marmot
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shirokuma Dango
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (66 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 癒しの女神の実験台（モルモット）
  • 英語名: Iyashi no Megami no Marmot

あらすじ

After working continuously in a shady business, his body and soul are in shambles. As he was walking without an umbrella in the rain, a woman called out to him:

“Have you been comforted lately?”

Arriving at the address on the business card he had received, he was enlisted as a ‘massage model’ (also known as a marmot) at the comfort industry specialty school, Shichijou Salon Arts Academy. His body, soul and nether regions, are comforted by the whispers of the goddesses at the school. Will he be able to safely regain his healthy body!?
